verdict.rationale: Steel's first-party integration docs describe tools that extract data and return typed results: the AI SDK integration says it will "extract, return typed results", and the Pydantic AI and OpenAI Agents SDK integrations describe typed browser agents. The Pi extension also claims to "extract structured data". The schema typing appears to come from the paired agent frameworks, though. Steel's own browser tools are documented only as markdown, readability, screenshot and PDF conversion. missing for 10: a native schema-validated extraction endpoint in Steel's API (Zod/Pydantic schema in, validated JSON out), detailed docs on schema definition and validation behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
